full_prompt_en: A square sepia-toned ink and charcoal illustration shows two figures leaning toward each other within a dark, swirling atmosphere. The background at the upper left is almost black with dense crossed strokes; it loosens into smoky gray-brown marks toward the right and lower edge. At left, a dark-haired man bends forward, his face close to the woman beside him. His white rolled sleeve and dark vest create strong alternating light and shadow, and one arm extends outward toward the left edge with an open hand. At center right, a woman in a pale puff-sleeved bodice and long dark skirt turns her face up toward him. One hand presses lightly against his chest, while her other arm reaches back to the right as though balancing herself. Her dark hair is gathered away from the face, which is rendered with fine tonal shading and a clear profile against the surrounding dark. The skirt spreads through the lower right in many fine curving lines, then breaks into an indistinct field of churned texture. Across the lower left and foreground, pale billowing forms roll beneath the figures, resembling smoke or agitated water without a hard horizon. Short scratches, looping marks, and crosshatching build their clothes and the environment in the same restless visual language. Bright paper-toned highlights collect on the woman's face, sleeves, and the man's sleeve; the dark upper background makes these areas appear illuminated. Light seems to come from the lower left and front, leaving the man's face and clothing partly submerged in deep shadow. The overall composition is dramatic and intimate, holding a close encounter between two figures inside a turbulent, richly hatched monochrome field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕褐色墨笔与炭笔插画呈现两个人物在深暗、旋动的氛围中相互靠近。左上背景由密集交叉笔迹压成近黑色，向右边和下缘逐渐松散成烟雾般的灰棕笔迹。左侧一名深发男子俯身前倾，面孔贴近身旁女子。他卷起的白袖与深色背心形成强烈明暗交替，一只手臂向画面左缘伸出，手掌张开。中央偏右，一名女子身穿浅色泡袖上衣和深色长裙，抬脸望向他。一只手轻抵他的胸前，另一臂向右后方伸展，仿佛正在保持平衡。深发向后束起，面孔以细密明度塑形，在周围暗色前呈现清楚侧影。裙摆通过许多纤细弯线铺向右下，继而碎散成不明确的翻涌肌理。左下与前景，浅色鼓起的形状在人物下方卷动，像烟雾或激荡的水，却没有坚硬地平线。短刮痕、环绕线与交叉排线用相同躁动的视觉语言搭建衣服和环境。接近纸色的亮处集中在女子面庞、衣袖及男子袖子上；深色上方背景让这些区域显得受光。光仿佛从左下前方照来，使男子面部和衣服部分沉入浓重阴影。整体构图戏剧化而亲密，把两人贴近的瞬间放进动荡、排线丰富的单色场域。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome drawing relies on layered charcoal, ink hatching, and rubbed sepia-gray tone. Fine parallel strokes turn with the contours of a form, while dense crosshatching pools into almost black shadow and loose scratches dissolve other edges into atmosphere. Cream paper remains as the brightest value, creating flashes of light without opaque white paint. Figures or focal masses receive precise anatomical and fabric modeling, but peripheral space becomes a swirl of broken directional marks. The palette stays within warm gray, brown, cream, and black, making value, texture, and stroke direction the main organizing tools. Light concentrates on a few exposed planes and drops abruptly into a dark upper field. The composition favors diagonal movement and close overlap, with a turbulent lower margin supporting a tightly focused center. The overall effect is theatrical and antique, combining refined draftsmanship with emotionally charged mark making.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色画法依靠层叠炭笔、墨线排线与擦揉的棕灰色调。纤细平行笔迹顺着形体轮廓转向，密集交叉排线汇聚为近黑阴影，松散刮线又使其他边缘融入气氛。奶油色纸面保留为最亮明度，无需不透明白颜料便形成闪光。焦点形体得到准确的结构和褶皱塑造，周边空间却变成断续定向笔迹的旋涡。色板局限于暖灰、棕、奶油色与黑色，使明度、肌理和落笔方向成为主要组织工具。光集中在少数外露平面上，随即陡然落入深暗的上部。构图偏爱斜向运动和紧密遮挡，翻腾的下缘支撑高度集中的中央。整体效果富戏剧性且带古旧感，把精湛素描与充满情绪的落笔结合起来。
theme_en: Two figures leaning toward each other within a swirling sepia drawing
theme_zh: 两个人物在旋动的棕褐色素描中相互靠近
name: Norman Lindsay
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
